entities.summary: The Revolutionary Febrerista Party is a social democratic political party in Paraguay. It was established in 1951 by Rafael Franco, President of Paraguay from the February Revolution of 1936 until his overthrow in August 1937. Revolutionary Febrerista Party is a political party in Asunción, established in 1951-12-11. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
